description: This PHP script initializes the menu for the CalendarAccount module in SuiteCRM, providing links related to calendar account management, including creating new accounts and listing existing ones. It also checks user permissions and integrates with the CalendarSync class.

classes.name: CalendarSync
classes.description: A class responsible for synchronizing calendar data, with singleton access via getInstance() and methods to check calendar accounts.

methods.name: CalendarSync::getInstance
methods.description: Returns the singleton instance of the CalendarSync class.

methods.name: CalendarSync->hasPersonalCalendarAccount
methods.description: Checks if the current user has a personal calendar account.
